paras: The killing of Nathan Green was the fatal shooting of a Black man, also called Charlie Williams, by a citizens' posse of about forty in the Madison section of Nashville, Tennessee, early on Friday, July 11, 1919. Green, accused of burglary, died a few hours later at the county jail, and two Black members of the posse were seriously wounded in the chase.

According to a Nashville dispatch, Black men had recently robbed a number of houses in the vicinity of the Madison section. Residents organized on Thursday night to catch the burglars, with Frank Stull in charge of the posse.

Early the next morning the posse came upon a group of men it took to be the burglars, and Stull ordered them to halt. The men fled instead, and the dispatch, partly illegible in the surviving text, describes what followed as a "pitched battle" between the citizens and the burglars. Green "gave fight to the posse," in the dispatch's words, and was shot; the others escaped.

Oliver Batres and Sam Robinson, described as Black men who were members of the posse, were shot and seriously wounded during the chase, though the text does not make clear who fired the shots. Green died a few hours later at the county jail.
The only account says that the authorities considered Green a burglar; no report of an inquest, arrests or charges appears in the coverage.

The shooting reached the Black press only through the Dallas Express, which printed the Nashville dispatch on July 12 under the headline "BURGLARS AND POSSE IN FIGHT: ONE DEAD, TWO HURT." The paper ran the posse's and the authorities' version without comment, calling Green "a negro burglar" and noting that the wounded included "two negro members of the posse." No editorial response or follow-up story appears in the Black papers searched.

reader.title: Killing of Nathan Green
bases: A citizens' posse of about forty, organized to catch burglars, shot Nathan Green, described as a Black burglar, who died at the county jail (A2).
Only the Dallas Express reported the shooting (A2); the other linked article is about a different episode in Maryland (A1).

quotes: Nathan Green, alias Charlie Williams, a negro burglar, was shot to death, when he gave fight to the posse.
Oliver Batres and Sam Robinson, negroes, who formed a posse, were shot and seriously wounded by claws.
In the chase two negro members of the posse were shot.
